title: Nigeria Vocational Enterprise Institutions
description: Current active VEIs returned by the Digital NBTE approved VEI/Training Center/MCP register, filtered to rows explicitly categorized as Vocational Enterprise Institute (VEI).
methodology: The live Digital NBTE register was queried for all institutions and rows explicitly categorized as Vocational Enterprise Institute (VEI). Skill Training Center and Master Craft Person rows were excluded. The public contract contains only the five roster fields; this pass adds no websites, logos or runtime support.
source_hierarchy: NBTE Vocational, Technical and Skills Development department

sources.title: Approved Vocational Enterprise Institutions (VEIs)/Training Centers/MCP
sources.retrieval_method: POST CategoryCode=VAll; retained rows with Category exactly Vocational Enterprise Institute (VEI)
sources.status_semantics: Current portal category; response also includes STC and MCP rows, which are excluded from this dataset
limitations: portal response does not expose a publication date
the live response is a combined VEI/STC/MCP listing

sources.title: The Department of Vocational, Technical and Skills Development
sources.purpose: Confirms the VEI regulatory unit and its accreditation/monitoring role

sources.title: 2025 reform notice
sources.purpose: IEI/NID reform boundary; does not abolish the separate VEI portal category

sources.title: The New TVET Initiative
sources.purpose: Confirms current accreditation process for MCPs, STCs and VEIs

reform_relationship: IEIs and the NID programme were abolished by the 2025 reform notice. VEIs remain separately represented in the live Digital NBTE portal, which groups them with STCs and MCPs for retrieval; only explicitly VEI-categorized rows are included here.
inclusion_rules: Current live Digital NBTE row categorized exactly as Vocational Enterprise Institute (VEI)
Ownership and physical state taken from the live register
exclusion_rules: upgraded IEI records unless currently categorized VEI
withdrawn, suspended, closed or wrong-category records
accreditation_status_policy: The live Digital NBTE category is treated as the current inclusion signal. The 2025 IEI withdrawal notice is not applied to VEI rows unless a current source explicitly identifies the VEI row as withdrawn.
known_limitations: The portal combines VEIs, STCs and MCPs and does not publish a separate VEI-only downloadable snapshot.
The live response has no publication date; retrieval date and response hash provide reproducibility for this snapshot.
The portal does not expose detailed licence dates in the all-rows response.
update_frequency: Review on each Digital NBTE register change and material NBTE accreditation or withdrawal notice.
rights: SoftData compilation, schema and metadata are CC BY 4.0. NBTE source material retains its own rights. This pass adds only a static roster foundation; websites, logos and API routes are deferred.
